description: Source code for FactoryHal.cpp implementing dynamic loading and service management for Android audio HALs, supporting multiple HAL versions and interfaces.

methods.name: createHalService
methods.description: Dynamically loads the HAL library and creates the HAL service interface.

methods.name: hasAidlHalService
methods.description: Checks if an AIDL HAL service is declared and available.

methods.name: hasHidlHalService
methods.description: Checks if a HIDL HAL service is available by querying the transport.

methods.name: hasHalService
methods.description: Determines HAL service availability based on version type.

methods.name: createPreferredImpl
methods.description: Creates the preferred HAL implementation by selecting the most recent compatible version.
